changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION audit_session_update() RETURNS trigger AS $$ DECLARE audit_sid_hash TEXT := encode(sha256(NEW.sid::bytea), 'hex'); BEGIN IF COALESCE(NEW.sess->'__fastifySessionMetadata'->>'generation', NEW.sid) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.sess->'__fastifySessionMetadata'->>'generation', OLD.sid) THEN UPDATE user_session_audit SET ended_at = NOW(), end_reason = COALESCE(end_reason, 'rotated') WHERE sid_hash = audit_sid_hash AND ended_at IS NULL; INSERT INTO user_session_audit (sid_hash, user_email, idp) VALUES (audit_sid_hash, NEW.sess->>'userId', NEW.sess->>'idp'); ELSE UPDATE user_session_audit SET user_email = COALESCE(user_email, NEW.sess->>'userId'), idp = COALESCE(idp, NEW.sess->>'idp') WHERE sid_hash = audit_sid_hash AND ended_at IS NULL AND (user_email IS NULL OR idp IS NULL); END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql

rollback.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION audit_session_update() RETURNS trigger AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE user_session_audit SET user_email = COALESCE(user_email, NEW.sess->>'userId'), idp = COALESCE(idp, NEW.sess->>'idp') WHERE sid_hash = encode(sha256(NEW.sid::bytea), 'hex') AND ended_at IS NULL AND (user_email IS NULL OR idp IS NULL); RETURN NEW; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql
